youtube_title: Jesus... I Can't Ask Anyone For Help 😔 | Galatians 6:2 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus to a real, unspoken prayer.

She'd rather carry her struggles alone than risk being a burden, even when she's close to breaking.

She: Jesus... why can't I ask anyone for help even when I'm drowning? 😔
She: I typed the message four times. Deleted it four times.
Jesus: You're not afraid of the words. You're afraid of being a burden.
She: Even my closest friend thinks I'm the strong one.
She: So I carry it. Everyone already has their own problems, right?
Jesus: That's the lie. Burdens were made to be carried together. That's why I told you to carry each other's.
Jesus: Asking for help isn't a burden. Silence is.

“Carry one another’s burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.”
Galatians 6:2 (BSB)

Asking for help isn't a burden. Silence is.

💬 Who would you actually call if you needed help tonight? 👇

An imagined reply. The Scripture is quoted as written.
